scenes.heading: Meet Momo
scenes.narration: Hi! I'm Momo — a little desktop companion who lives in the corner of your screen. In the next minute, I'll show you what I can do for your workday.

scenes.heading: What I handle for you
bullets: Draft and send email — I always ask before sending
Schedule Teams meetings, checking conflicts first
Take meeting notes in Hindi, English, or Hinglish
Keep your to-dos in OneNote — ticked and struck through
scenes.narration: Just press the hotkey and speak. I draft your emails and always ask before sending. I schedule your Teams meetings after checking your calendar. I quietly take notes in your meetings — even in Hindi or Hinglish — and I keep your to-do list alive in OneNote.

scenes.heading: Minutes I give back — every day
scenes.narration: Here's what that adds up to. Around forty five minutes on email triage, thirty on meeting notes, and more on scheduling and hunting for files. That's nearly two hours a day — over nine hours every week, back in your hands.

scenes.heading: Press Control Alt M.
scenes.narration: Ready to try? Press Control, Alt, M — and just speak. I'll take it from there. See you on your desktop!
